title: Switchyard forecaster: cost & tokens per model call

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT run FROM (SELECT 'latest (auto)' AS run, toDateTime64('2100-01-01 00:00:00', 6) AS t UNION ALL SELECT metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')] AS run, max(start_time) AS t FROM events_full WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast' GROUP BY run) WHERE run != '' ORDER BY t DESC

panels.title: Overall cost per run: actual vs predicted
panels.description: actual_cost = real total. predicted_sum_of_next_calls = sum of per-call predictions (= Langfuse predicted:opus-4-8). predicted_at_task_start = whole-task bill predicted before call 1. predicted_at_last_call = estimate before the final call.

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (SELECT trace_id, metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')] AS run, toInt32OrZero(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.call_index')]) AS call
           FROM events_full WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast'),
c AS (SELECT f.run AS run, f.call AS call, maxIf(s.value, s.name='actual_call_cost') AS actual,
             maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_next_call_cost_mid') AS pred_mid, maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_total_task_cost') AS pred_total
      FROM scores s JOIN f ON s.trace_id=f.trace_id GROUP BY run, call)
SELECT run, sum(actual) AS actual_cost, sum(pred_mid) AS predicted_sum_of_next_calls,
       argMin(pred_total, call) AS predicted_at_task_start, argMax(pred_total, call) AS predicted_at_last_call
FROM c WHERE run != '' GROUP BY run ORDER BY max(call) DESC

panels.title: Cost by model: actual vs predicted (same as Langfuse)

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(provided_model_name='predicted:opus-4-8','predicted:opus-4-8', provided_model_name) AS model, sum(total_cost) AS cost FROM events_full WHERE type='GENERATION' AND provided_model_name != '' GROUP BY model ORDER BY model

panels.title: All runs: total actual vs predicted

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(actual_cost) AS actual, sum(predicted_sum_of_next_calls) AS predicted_per_call_sum, sum(predicted_at_task_start) AS predicted_at_start FROM (WITH f AS (SELECT trace_id, metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')] AS run, toInt32OrZero(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.call_index')]) AS call
           FROM events_full WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast'),
c AS (SELECT f.run AS run, f.call AS call, maxIf(s.value, s.name='actual_call_cost') AS actual,
             maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_next_call_cost_mid') AS pred_mid, maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_total_task_cost') AS pred_total
      FROM scores s JOIN f ON s.trace_id=f.trace_id GROUP BY run, call)
SELECT run, sum(actual) AS actual_cost, sum(pred_mid) AS predicted_sum_of_next_calls,
       argMin(pred_total, call) AS predicted_at_task_start, argMax(pred_total, call) AS predicted_at_last_call
FROM c WHERE run != '' GROUP BY run)

WITH fc AS (SELECT trace_id, toInt32OrZero(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.call_index')]) AS call FROM events_full
         WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast' AND metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')] = if('$run'='latest (auto)', (SELECT argMax(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')], start_time) FROM events_full WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast'), '$run'))
SELECT
  anyIf(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.task_id')], name='lightgbm.forecast') AS task,
  anyIf(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.gen_ai.response.model')], type='GENERATION' AND provided_model_name!='predicted:opus-4-8') AS model,
  anyIf(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.switchyard.algorithm')], name='libsy.run') AS router,
  anyIf(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.forecast.checkpoint')], name='lightgbm.forecast') AS predictor_checkpoint,
  anyIf(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.forecast.variant')], name='lightgbm.forecast') AS variant,
  substring(anyIf(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.forecast.checkpoint_sha256')], name='lightgbm.forecast'), 1, 12) AS checkpoint_sha,
  anyIf(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'resourceAttributes.service.name')], name='lightgbm.forecast') AS agent_service,
  countIf(name='agent.call') AS calls_done,
  sumIf(total_cost, type='GENERATION' AND provided_model_name!='predicted:opus-4-8') AS actual_cost
FROM events_full WHERE trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM fc)

panels.title: Next model call: actual vs predicted cost ($)
panels.description: Before each call the forecaster predicts a cost band (dashed low/high) and best guess (mid). Red = actual.

targets.rawSql:
WITH fc AS (SELECT trace_id, toInt32OrZero(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.call_index')]) AS call FROM events_full
         WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast' AND metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')] = if('$run'='latest (auto)', (SELECT argMax(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')], start_time) FROM events_full WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast'), '$run'))
SELECT fc.call AS call, if(countIf(s.name='actual_call_cost')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='actual_call_cost')) AS actual, if(countIf(s.name='pred_next_call_cost_mid')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_next_call_cost_mid')) AS predicted_mid,
       if(countIf(s.name='pred_next_call_cost_low')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_next_call_cost_low')) AS predicted_low, if(countIf(s.name='pred_next_call_cost_high')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_next_call_cost_high')) AS predicted_high
FROM scores s JOIN fc ON s.trace_id=fc.trace_id GROUP BY call ORDER BY call

panels.title: Next call tokens: Uncached input tokens
panels.description: Predicted band for the next call vs actual tokens. Empty band = not predicted by this checkpoint.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
f AS (SELECT trace_id, toInt32OrZero(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.call_index')]) AS call,
             toFloat64OrNull(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.forecast.next_call.uncached_input_tokens.lower_inclusive')]) AS lo,
             if(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.forecast.next_call.uncached_input_tokens.upper_unbounded')]='true', NULL, toFloat64OrNull(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.forecast.next_call.uncached_input_tokens.upper_exclusive')])) AS hi
      FROM events_full WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast' AND metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')] = if('$run'='latest (auto)', (SELECT argMax(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')], start_time) FROM events_full WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast'), '$run')),
a AS (SELECT trace_id, toFloat64OrNull(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.actual.uncached_input_tokens')]) AS actual FROM events_full
      WHERE name='agent.call' AND metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')] = if('$run'='latest (auto)', (SELECT argMax(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')], start_time) FROM events_full WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast'), '$run'))
SELECT f.call AS call, a.actual AS actual, if(f.hi IS NULL, f.lo, (f.lo+f.hi)/2) AS predicted_mid,
       f.lo AS predicted_low, f.hi AS predicted_high
FROM f LEFT JOIN a ON f.trace_id=a.trace_id ORDER BY call

panels.title: Whole task: predicted final bill vs actual ($)
panels.description: predicted_total = spent so far + predicted remaining, at each call. Dashed red = real final bill (so far, while running).

targets.rawSql:
WITH fc AS (SELECT trace_id, toInt32OrZero(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.call_index')]) AS call FROM events_full
         WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast' AND metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')] = if('$run'='latest (auto)', (SELECT argMax(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')], start_time) FROM events_full WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast'), '$run'))
SELECT call, actual_cost_so_far, predicted_total, predicted_remaining, max(actual_cost_so_far) OVER () AS actual_final_bill
FROM (SELECT fc.call AS call, if(countIf(s.name='actual_cost_so_far')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='actual_cost_so_far')) AS actual_cost_so_far, if(countIf(s.name='pred_total_task_cost')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_total_task_cost')) AS predicted_total,
             if(countIf(s.name='pred_remaining_task_cost')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_remaining_task_cost')) AS predicted_remaining
      FROM scores s JOIN fc ON s.trace_id=fc.trace_id GROUP BY call) ORDER BY call

panels.title: Remaining model calls: predicted vs actual
panels.description: Actual remaining is final only once the run finishes.

targets.rawSql:
WITH fc AS (SELECT trace_id, toInt32OrZero(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.call_index')]) AS call FROM events_full
         WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast' AND metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')] = if('$run'='latest (auto)', (SELECT argMax(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')], start_time) FROM events_full WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast'), '$run'))
SELECT call, predicted_remaining_calls, (max(call) OVER ()) - call + 1 AS actual_remaining_calls
FROM (SELECT fc.call AS call, if(countIf(s.name='pred_remaining_calls')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_remaining_calls')) AS predicted_remaining_calls
      FROM scores s JOIN fc ON s.trace_id=fc.trace_id GROUP BY call) ORDER BY call

panels.title: Cost by IR phase: actual vs predicted ($)
panels.description: Phase = ir.observed.phase of the call (what the call actually did).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT phase, sum(actual) AS actual, sum(predicted) AS predicted FROM (WITH fc AS (SELECT trace_id, toInt32OrZero(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.call_index')]) AS call FROM events_full
         WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast' AND metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')] = if('$run'='latest (auto)', (SELECT argMax(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')], start_time) FROM events_full WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast'), '$run')),
ph AS (SELECT trace_id, metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.ir.observed.phase')] AS phase FROM events_full WHERE name='agent.call')
SELECT ph.phase AS phase, if(countIf(s.name='actual_call_cost')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='actual_call_cost')) AS actual, if(countIf(s.name='pred_next_call_cost_mid')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_next_call_cost_mid')) AS predicted
FROM scores s JOIN fc ON s.trace_id=fc.trace_id JOIN ph ON ph.trace_id=fc.trace_id
GROUP BY s.trace_id, phase) WHERE phase != '' GROUP BY phase ORDER BY actual DESC

panels.title: Per-call details (newest first): IR phase, tokens, cost
panels.description: phase_before = ir.source.phase at forecast time; phase_after = ir.observed.phase of the call.

targets.rawSql:
WITH fc AS (SELECT trace_id, toInt32OrZero(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.call_index')]) AS call FROM events_full
         WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast' AND metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')] = if('$run'='latest (auto)', (SELECT argMax(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.demo.run_id')], start_time) FROM events_full WHERE name='lightgbm.forecast'), '$run')),
sc AS (SELECT s.trace_id AS trace_id, if(countIf(s.name='actual_call_cost')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='actual_call_cost')) AS actual_cost, if(countIf(s.name='pred_next_call_cost_low')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_next_call_cost_low')) AS pred_low,
              if(countIf(s.name='pred_next_call_cost_high')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_next_call_cost_high')) AS pred_high, if(countIf(s.name='pred_remaining_calls')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='pred_remaining_calls')) AS pred_remaining_calls,
              if(countIf(s.name='next_call_in_band')=0, NULL, maxIf(s.value, s.name='next_call_in_band')) AS in_band
       FROM scores s WHERE s.trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM fc) GROUP BY s.trace_id),
sp AS (SELECT trace_id,
              anyIf(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.ir.source.phase')], name='lightgbm.forecast') AS phase_before,
              anyIf(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.ir.observed.phase')], name='agent.call') AS phase_after,
              anyIf(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.ir.observed.categories')], name='agent.call') AS categories_raw,
              anyIf(toFloat64OrNull(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.actual.uncached_input_tokens')]), name='agent.call') AS uncached_in,
              anyIf(toFloat64OrNull(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.actual.cache_read_input_tokens')]), name='agent.call') AS cache_read,
              anyIf(toFloat64OrNull(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.actual.cache_write_input_tokens')]), name='agent.call') AS cache_write,
              anyIf(toFloat64OrNull(metadata_values[indexOf(metadata_names,'attributes.actual.output_tokens')]), name='agent.call') AS output
       FROM events_full WHERE trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM fc) GROUP BY trace_id)
SELECT fc.call AS call, sp.phase_before AS phase_before, sp.phase_after AS phase_after,
       sp.uncached_in, sp.cache_read, sp.cache_write, sp.output,
       sc.actual_cost, sc.pred_low, sc.pred_high, sc.in_band, sc.pred_remaining_calls
FROM fc LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.trace_id=fc.trace_id LEFT JOIN sp ON sp.trace_id=fc.trace_id ORDER BY call DESC
